"'''This Minute'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] sung by [[Mermeia]], a [[holograph]]ic image, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] on a [[Mind evaporator/Legends|mind evaporator]], viewed by the elderly [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]].

==Behind the scenes==
The song was sung by actress and singer [[Diahann Carroll]].

==Appearances==
*''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' {{1st}}

==Song Lyrics==
''If we could only bend this minute''<br />
''Infinitely extend this minute''<br />
''Then I could live my whole life right now''<br />
''Reality is sweet this minute''<br />
''Can't we repeat and repeat this minute?''<br />
''Why can't it be always right now?''<br />
''I've parted with yesterday.''<br />
''Yesterday's moment is cold''<br />
''All I ask is this moment to hold''<br />
''How can we ever lose this minute?''<br />
''From all my life, I choose this minute''<br />
''I will give up the old and the new''<br />
''Sharing with you this minute now''<br />
''If I could just hold my breath and close my eyes and not make a sound''<br />
''Will the universe stop going 'round?''<br />
''Still the universe keeps going 'round and 'round''<br />
''And on and on and on and on and on''<br />
''A minute's almost gone''<br />
''How can we ever, ever lose this minute?''<br />
''From all my life, I choose this minute''<br />
''I will never need anything more than living for this minute now''<br />
''This minute now (x10)''<br />
